criterion: M2 exit criterion 1 (ROADMAP.md): ten named glTF models import and render on the CPU reference, D3D12 and WebGPU

source.verification: each file's git blob hash (git hash-object) equals the hash in the repository tree at that commit

approval: The author approved this download on 2026-10-10 (relayed verbatim: "You have my yes."). The files are kept outside the repository, on D:, and are not redistributed.
licences: Every model is CC0-1.0 or CC-BY-4.0 only. Four first picks were replaced before any run: DamagedHelmet (CC-BY-NC), Duck (SCEA licence), CesiumMilkTruck (trademark notice) and BrainStem (Poser EULA), so that none carries a non-commercial or proprietary term.

models.name: Fox
models.exercises: GLB, skinned (imported in bind pose; skins are not read)

models.name: ToyCar
models.exercises: GLB, many nodes and material extensions (geometry only is read)

bounds.import: every model loads with no AssetError
bounds.cpu: the CPU render's output hashes are byte-identical on MSVC, GCC and WebAssembly and are recorded in a golden manifest
bounds.gpu: on D3D12 and WebGPU the GPU certificate's verdict is verified against the CPU reference (the same reconcile the built-in scene uses)

does_not_prove: Textures, materials beyond base colour, skinning or animation (none is read), or how the models look.
